## Body

To map seats to roles in a round:
`pij directory | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);[print(r['id'],[l['seat'] for l in r.get('lineage',[]) if not l.get('to')]) for r in d['roles']]"`
(lineage entries without `to` are the live holders.)

At 10:31 on 06 Nov: pa pij-watchful-badger, pm-001 pij-steady-otter, delivery pij-swift-kestrel, docs-system pij-wooden-lungfish (replaced pij-careful-heron, which was 611k and cold; prime said don't wake it), security pij-wary-lynx, performance pij-frugal-wombat.
